Provide us a reasonable explanation why somebody would divert from their longstanding estate plan, given all the facts, why somebody was deprived of counsel, why you didn't notify any other family members on the day that you did it, why you solely added Lynette Hughes to the deed. He testified at trial. That was his idea. His mother did not ask for that. He put her on the deed himself. You have to explain all of these things. And if you do, if you provide a reasonable explanation, then the presumption then is rebutted and it shifts back. They did not do that. There is no explanation. I think that the law says that this case has to be overruled and that it cannot be affirmed. It has to be overruled. The trial court's ruling is erroneous as a matter of law.
